statement: ∃ e : Red p M ≃ₗ[ℤ] (MR p M ⧸ ((Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) • (⊤ : Submodule ℤ (MR p M)))), ∀ u : MR p M, e ((1 : ZMod p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) = Submodule.Quotient.mk u
proof:
let I : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}
let a : ZMod p ≃ₗ[ℤ] (ℤ ⧸ I) := (Int.quotientSpanNatEquivZMod p).symm.toAddEquiv.toIntLinearEquiv
let e := (TensorProduct.congr a (LinearEquiv.refl ℤ (MR p M))).trans (TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul (MR p M) I)
refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
intro u
have ha : a (1 : ZMod p) = 1 := (Int.quotientSpanNatEquivZMod p).symm.map_one
change TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul (MR p M) I (a 1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) = _
rw [ha, TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_one_tmul]
